evidence: Labeled 'Mining', touches `src/node/block_template_manager.cpp`, `src/interfaces/mining.h`, and adds functional and unit tests for block template memory tracking.
rationale: External mining clients such as Stratum v2 template providers can hold block templates indefinitely, pinning evicted transactions in memory with zero visibility. Providing `getMemoryLoad()` and weak-pointer tracking in `BlockTemplateManager` directly serves active external mining consumers (e.g. stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63) and lays the groundwork for bounding template memory usage.
